description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the number of datasets over time, categorized by language attributes. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Year" and displays discrete years in chronological order from 2012 to 2022. The vertical value axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and utilizes a logarithmic scale, featuring major horizontal gridlines and tick labels at $10^1$ and $10^2$. The data is visually arranged into groups of bars for each year. A legend titled "Languages" indicates that blue bars represent a value of "1", while an orange rectangle and a grey rectangle are displayed in the legend without accompanying text labels. Blue bars are present for every year on the horizontal axis, exhibiting a general increase in height from the shortest bars in 2012 and 2013 (approximately 2 datasets) to the tallest bar in 2021 (approximately 150 to 200 datasets). Orange bars appear grouped to the right of the blue bars starting in the year 2017; the shortest orange bar occurs in 2018 (approximately 2 datasets) and the tallest in 2020 (approximately 20 datasets). The categories are sorted chronologically from left to right. Visually, the bars for the final year, 2022, are distinguished from the rest of the chart by being rendered in lighter, faded shades of blue (approximately 30 datasets) and orange (approximately 2 datasets), whereas the bars for 2012 through 2021 use solid, darker shades.
